ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails and potential wrongdoing in the childcare system
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the flow of funds
questions: What are the main sources of funding for childcare programs?
How are these funds being allocated and used?
ideas.insight: By tracking the flow of funds, we may uncover patterns of fraud and wrongdoing within the childcare system.
